title: City of San Diego Crews Prepare for Second Storm
description:
San Diego is ready to face this week’s wet weather and king tides, with City crews actively preparing. Our teams will be monitoring storm drains and addressing flooding, as well as downed tree limbs and branches.

Join us in staying ahead of the storm by clearing debris from drains near your home, securing your trash and recycling bins, and turning off irrigation to help prevent runoff. 

Report any storm issues via the Get It Done app or by calling 619-527-7500.

Learn more about storm preparedness here: insidesandiego.org/residents-encouraged-prepare-second-holiday-storm
